input.command: python -c 'import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, os; os.makedirs("./out", exist_ok=True); q="SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, SUM(number_of_motorist_killed) AS motorist_deaths, SUM(number_of_cyclist_killed) AS cyclist_deaths FROM read_parquet(\"./data/crashes.parquet\") WHERE year(crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"; df=duckdb.sql(q).df(); df[["year","motorist_deaths","cyclist_deaths"]].to_csv("./out/values_1.csv", index=False); years=df["year"].astype(int).to_numpy(); x=np.arange(len(df)); w=0.38; fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.8)); ax.bar(x-w/2,df["motorist_deaths"],width=w,label="Motorists",color="#2369a1"); ax.bar(x+w/2,df["cyclist_deaths"],width=w,label="Cyclists",color="#e17c32"); ax.set_xticks(x,years); ax.set_xlabel("Year"); ax.set_ylabel("Deaths (annual total)"); ax.set_title("Motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC crashes, 2013–2025"); ax.legend(frameon=False); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); ax.set_axisbelow(True); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig("./out/option_1.png",dpi=180); plt.close(fig); df["combined_deaths"]=df["motorist_deaths"]+df["cyclist_deaths"]; df["motorist_share_pct"]=100*df["motorist_deaths"]/df["combined_deaths"]; df["cyclist_share_pct"]=100*df["cyclist_deaths"]/df["combined_deaths"]; df[["year","motorist_deaths","cyclist_deaths","combined_deaths","motorist_share_pct","cyclist_share_pct"]].to_csv("./out/values_2.csv",index=False,float_format="%.2f"); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.8)); ax.set_xlabel("Year"); ax.set_ylabel("Share of motorist + cyclist deaths (%)"); ax.set_title("Composition of motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC crashes, 2013–2025"); ax.legend(frameon=False,loc="upper right");
